body.prompt: Editorial storybook illustration for a Korean finance explainer video. Hand-drawn deep navy ink linework with soft watercolor wash on warm ivory paper texture, limited palette of navy, ivory and muted gold with small warm accents, gentle light, clear single focal point, calm and intelligent mood, generous empty space around the subject. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. Scene: Winter evening in 2011 in a narrow Myeongdong alley in Seoul: a long line of people in winter coats waiting outside a small spicy braised chicken restaurant with a glowing sign, breath visible in the cold air, a mother and her teenage daughter seen from behind walking past and looking at the line, neon reflections on the wet pavement.
